# typeassert: else-if chain triggers IfStmt continue in enclosing block search
typeassert {
	var x I
	x.M() == 1 -> x.(m1)
}
-- x.go --
package p

type I interface{ M() int }
type m1 int

func (m1) M() int { return 1 }

func g(x I) {
	{
		if false {
			return
		} else if x.M() != 1 {
			return
		}
		_ = x
	}
}
-- stdout --
diff old/x.go new/x.go
--- old/x.go
+++ new/x.go
@@ -12,6 +12,7 @@
 		} else if x.M() != 1 {
 			return
 		}
+		x := x.(m1)
 		_ = x
 	}
 }
